title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
abstract: arXiv:2611.08269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Three inputs from a blind GPT-5.6-luna writer that never saw the program reached 0.070. Two further frozen stages enlarged the menu to 1491 fragments and then added 233 hard distractors that match the legacy output on typical inputs. translated_title: 被接受但实则错误：API迁移后LLM代码修复的静默失败
translated_abstract: 在运行时或API迁移之后，经LLM修复的程序可能顺利运行却返回错误结果，而基于典型测试输入的发布检查会将其放行发布。我们报告了一项预注册研究，包含73个任务，覆盖CPython、Node.js和SQLite中60个有文档记录的变更。每个候选修复都在真实运行时上针对未公开的契约执行。在整个修复空间中，基于典型输入的全断言门检查放行了0.410比例的错误修复。一个根据发布说明编写的边缘输入将该比例降至0.065，在15个未见过的集群上降至0.061。来自一个从未见过该程序的盲测GPT-5.6-luna编写者的三个输入达到了0.070。两个后续冻结阶段将候选菜单扩大至1491个片段，随后又添加了233个在典型输入上与遗留输出匹配的困难干扰项。边缘输入（0.058）和前沿模型编写者（0.058）通过了其预注册测试。然而，仍有0.168和0.153的困难错误程序通过了检查。
tldr: 预注册研究发现，API迁移后LLM修复的代码常能通过典型输入的断言检查却静默返回错误结果（漏检率0.410），而单个基于发布说明编写的边缘输入测试可将漏检率降至约0.06，但面对困难干扰项仍有约15%的错误程序被放行。
en_tdlr: A preregistered study shows that LLM code repairs after API migrations often pass typical-input assertion checks while silently returning wrong results (0.410 miss rate), but a single release-note-derived edge input cuts this to about 0.06, though around 15% of hard wrong programs still slip through.
